description_en: Creates a model provider template for model creation
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center create-model-provider-template --biz-type 1 --agent-provider OpenClaw --model-template-id mt-xxxx --provider-name bailian --config api_:_openai-completions_,_apiKey_:_sk-xxxx_,_baseUrl_:_https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateModelProviderTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated model template
parameters.name: model_template_id

parameters.help_en: The model provider name. The name must be unique within the same model template. The naming rules vary based on the value of ProviderType. For more information, see the description of ProviderType
parameters.help_zh: 模型服务商名称。同一模型模板下不可重复。命名规则因 ProviderType 而异，详见 ProviderType 说明
parameters.name: provider_name

parameters.help_en:
The model provider type. Different types impose different constraints on ProviderName and Config. Valid values:
WuyingCredit: WUYING credit plan. ProviderName must be set to wuying-credit. The template is created by copying from a system template, and Config is not required.
Managed: managed provider. System-reserved names such as wuying-credit cannot be used. Config is required.
Custom: user-defined provider. ProviderName must start with the prefix provider-. Config is required
parameters.help_zh:
模型服务商类型。不同类型对 ProviderName 和 Config 有不同约束：
WuyingCredit：无影积分包，ProviderName 必须为 wuying-credit，从系统模板复制创建，无需传入 Config
Managed：托管服务商，不可使用 wuying-credit 等系统保留名称，需传入 Config
Custom：用户自定义服务商，ProviderName 必须以 provider- 前缀开头，需传入 Config
parameters.name: provider_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the model provider template
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the model provider template
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The model provider configuration in JSON format, which contains connection information such as baseUrl, apiKey, and api. The apiKey is encrypted after creation. When ProviderType is set to WuyingCredit, this parameter is not required because the configuration is copied from the system template
parameters.help_zh: 模型服务商配置 JSON，包含 baseUrl、apiKey、api 等连接信息。apiKey 创建后将加密存储。当 ProviderType 为 WuyingCredit 时无需传入，将从系统模板复制
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the WUYING secure proxy. This parameter must be set to true when ProviderType is set to WuyingCredit
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用无影安全代理。当 ProviderType 为 WuyingCredit 时必须为 true
parameters.name: enable_wuying_proxy

ProviderTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the model provider template
